tasks.short: Develop site-specific health and safety protocols

steps.what: Inspect actual site hazards and spill or waste-handling conditions
inputs: actual site, materials and loading/transport activities
existing site records
outputs: observed site hazards and operational constraints

steps.what: Record actual site conditions, material properties and unresolved hazard information
inputs: observed site hazards and operational constraints
existing verified material information
outputs: confirmed site hazard record and information gaps

steps.what: Select site-specific spill contingency and waste loading or transport controls
inputs: confirmed site hazard record and information gaps
existing approved control procedures and applicable requirements
outputs: engineer-selected controls, responsibilities and stop conditions

steps.what: Draft the complete site-specific health and safety protocol from the selected controls
inputs: engineer-selected controls, responsibilities and stop conditions
confirmed site hazard record
existing approved protocol template
outputs: complete proposed site protocol

loop.purpose: Draft clear protocol wording from engineer-selected controls
loop.input: confirmed site hazards, selected controls, responsibilities, stop conditions and approved template
loop.output: draft protocol with source references and explicit unresolved fields
loop.check: Engineer checks operating sequence, hazard coverage, omissions, responsibilities and preservation of every selected control; model cannot choose or weaken controls
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual protocol wording
loop.why_not_simpler: Native template fields are deterministic; translating selected controls into site-specific instructions requires semantic wording and source-fidelity checks

steps.what: Review the finished protocol against actual hazards and selected safety controls
inputs: complete proposed site protocol
confirmed site hazard record
engineer-selected controls, responsibilities and stop conditions
outputs: checked complete final site protocol

steps.what: Approve the exact final protocol version for controlled internal issue
inputs: checked complete final site protocol
existing document issue authority
outputs: approved final protocol version and internal destination

steps.what: Issue the approved protocol in the same controlled internal document system
inputs: approved final protocol version and internal destination
outputs: controlled issued site protocol

tasks.design: Use an approved {DOCS} template and a bounded wording draft only after the engineer records actual {OTHER} site hazards and selects controls. Keep technical review and final issue approval after the completed protocol, with a separate controlled issue step.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generic protocol cannot establish actual site hazards or select adequate controls.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-grounded wording assistance can support documentation of engineer-made decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Choose controls that work under actual site and waste-handling conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Understand physical hazards and recognise missing information.

ambition.what: Support protocol documentation without automating safety decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; verify controlled-source access, issue authority and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: templates and bounded drafting can document engineer-selected controls for substantive review.

assumptions: OTHER means the physical site and handling activity. s1 obtains actual layout/activity, hazard and operational observations; s2 counts capture of location, material, hazard, constraint and unknown fields. Existing material owners supply verified properties and procedure owners supply approved requirements. Missing hazards or material facts require investigation, never invented instructions.

s3 counts selecting and recording actual control actions, responsibilities and stop conditions. Native protocol templates come first; only wording preparation falls to 60%. Physical assessment, control selection and final technical review remain full time.

Scenario assumes the engineer holds existing internal document issue authority. Required additional site or safety-manager approvals must retain and price their actual work before deployment; no approval is replaced. The completed protocol exists before s5/s6; changes void approval. Same-system issue is approximately zero time and earns no saving.

Boundary is developing the protocol, not conducting waste transport or emergency response. Provisional B=100, R=90, gross=10; incremental focal approved-source/template upkeep=2; net=8. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Required local sign-off chain and actual template coverage.
research_questions: Review protocol drafts against site findings and selected controls, including all technical correction and approval effort.

already_counted.description: Final technical protocol review retained at s5

incremental.description: Maintain approved control sources and inspect wording failures

approvals.approved_version: complete checked final protocol version and internal issue destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native templates already suffice; high allows three extra hours correcting procedure meaning beyond central net 8.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide environmental remediation and litigation technical support

steps.what: Clarify the remediation or litigation project's technical support question
inputs: project team's actual technical question and existing project scope
outputs: confirmed technical support question and constraints

steps.what: Retrieve applicable site evidence, remediation design records and authoritative requirements
inputs: confirmed technical support question and constraints
existing site/test/design records and governed requirements library
outputs: source-linked technical evidence and applicability questions

steps.what: Analyse remediation design or regulatory applicability and record the supported technical conclusion
inputs: source-linked technical evidence and applicability questions
confirmed technical support question and constraints
outputs: engineer-confirmed technical conclusion, calculations and limitations

steps.what: Prepare the technical response and source references for the named project recipient
inputs: engineer-confirmed technical conclusion, calculations and limitations
source-linked technical evidence
verified project recipient
outputs: complete proposed technical response and recipient

loop.purpose: Draft the explanation of an engineer-made technical conclusion
loop.input: confirmed conclusion, calculations, limitations and original evidence
loop.output: draft response with claim-level source references and recipient
loop.check: Engineer checks applicability reasoning, qualifications, causality and omissions against the actual analysis; the model cannot determine applicability or modify calculations
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual response
loop.why_not_simpler: Native response templates handle fields; explaining technical reasoning in free text requires semantic wording

steps.what: Review and approve the completed technical response and exact recipient
inputs: complete proposed technical response and recipient
engineer-confirmed technical conclusion, calculations and limitations
outputs: approved final technical response and recipient

steps.what: Send the approved technical response to the named external project recipient
inputs: approved final technical response and recipient
outputs: sent technical support response

steps.what: Record and confirm actual recipient feedback and follow-up requirements
inputs: sent technical support response
recipient's actual feedback or unresolved response status
outputs: confirmed final support follow-up note

steps.what: Save the confirmed follow-up note in the same project system
inputs: confirmed final support follow-up note
outputs: saved support follow-up note

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} and {OTHER} engineering-record searches to support evidence retrieval, then let the engineer perform the technical analysis. Draft its explanation from confirmed reasoning, approve the completed response and recipient, and separately send through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Retrieved requirements and calculations do not themselves establish applicability to the actual project.
tasks.enabler_now: Source filtering and bounded explanation drafting can support the surrounding work.
tasks.still_hard: Make a defensible technical judgement from site conditions and authoritative requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Understand limits and explain uncertainty to the project team.

ambition.what: Support current technical advice without delegating design or applicability decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; verify project confidentiality, source access and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering document systems support source retrieval and models can draft explanations of human-confirmed conclusions.

assumptions: OTHER means engineering design/test records and analysis software. Existing site/test owners supply actual location, sampling/result units and dates, design versions and source references; governed library owner supplies current authoritative requirements and applicability metadata. s2 reads originals and manually handles missing or stale sources; it does not decide applicability.

s3 counts analysis and capture of actual conclusion, calculation result, rationale and limitations. No model selects requirements or generates an unverified design. Native search and response templates come first. Central retains 70% of retrieval and 60% of response preparation, plus all substantive analysis and final review.

Scenario includes a real email to an external project client or adviser. Internal colleague response would use write_internal for its separate send. s5 follows the finished response and recipient; edits void approval. s7 counts actual feedback capture; a send flag is not agreement. Same-system save earns no saving.

Boundary is technical support, not implementing remediation or providing a legal determination. Provisional B=100, R=84.5, gross=15.5; incremental focal source/template upkeep=2; net=13.5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Current source-search coverage and actual response correction burden.
research_questions: Trace a support response from authoritative sources through technical reasoning, final message review and feedback.

already_counted.description: Final technical response review retained at s5

incremental.description: Maintain approved technical sources and inspect explanation failures

approvals.approved_version: complete final technical response and exact external recipient
confirmed final actual support follow-up note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native source and response workflows suffice; high allows four extra hours resolving source applicability and wording corrections beyond central net 13.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and present public project status briefings

steps.what: Gather and verify actual environmental project status, results and unresolved issues
inputs: existing actual milestone updates and verified monitoring results
current issue records
outputs: verified source-linked project status snapshot

steps.what: Choose the public briefing's context, limitations and information permitted for disclosure
inputs: verified source-linked project status snapshot
existing public communication authority and confidentiality constraints
outputs: confirmed public briefing scope and permitted claims

steps.what: Prepare public briefing material explaining the confirmed actual project status
inputs: confirmed public briefing scope and permitted claims
verified source-linked project status snapshot
outputs: complete proposed public briefing material

loop.purpose: Draft understandable explanations of verified project status
loop.input: permitted claims, verified status and explicit limitations
loop.output: briefing draft with claim-level sources and unresolved questions
loop.check: Engineer checks meaning, uncertainty, dates, causal claims and whether actual progress is distinguished from future plans
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual briefing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native status charts handle fields; explaining environmental results and caveats for a public audience needs semantic wording

steps.what: Review the completed public briefing against actual results and disclosure constraints
inputs: complete proposed public briefing material
verified source-linked project status snapshot
confirmed public briefing scope and permitted claims
outputs: checked final public briefing

steps.what: Approve the exact final briefing material and intended public audience
inputs: checked final public briefing
existing public communication authority and intended event audience
outputs: approved final briefing and public audience

steps.what: Present the approved project status briefing and answer public questions within its permitted scope
inputs: approved final briefing and public audience
public's actual questions
outputs: delivered public briefing and actual questions requiring follow-up

steps.what: Record and confirm actual public questions, answers and follow-up commitments
inputs: delivered public briefing and actual questions requiring follow-up
outputs: confirmed final public-briefing follow-up record

steps.what: Save the confirmed public-briefing follow-up record in the same project system
inputs: confirmed final public-briefing follow-up record
outputs: saved briefing follow-up record

tasks.design: Configure native {PROJECT} status views to gather actual updates and verified results, then assist explanation drafting in {DOCS}. Keep disclosure choices, completed-material review, approval and live presentation at {OTHER}, the public briefing venue, with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Planned milestones cannot stand in for actual progress or verified environmental results.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked status views and bounded explanation drafts can support preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Explain uncertainty clearly and answer questions responsibly.
tasks.human_edge: Understand public concerns and communicate the limits of current knowledge.

ambition.what: Support the existing public briefing without assuming extra presentations or automatic disclosure.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; verify disclosure authority, source access and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project systems can gather existing actual status fields and models can propose source-based explanations for a public audience.

assumptions: Existing work-package owners record actual status, completed date, unresolved issue and evidence reference; monitoring owners supply verified result, unit, sampling period and caveat. s1 reads/verifies these originals and includes manually obtaining missing updates. No planned completion is treated as actual and no new upstream capture is free.

s2 selects permitted claims and limitations; s3 drafts only those. Native views and briefing templates come first. Central retains 60% of gathering and drafting; disclosure judgement, completed-material review and live presentation remain unchanged.

Scenario assumes existing engineer public-briefing authority. Any required communications or project-owner approval must retain and price its work before deployment. Final briefing exists before s4/s5 and s6 presentation. Material changes invalidate approval; unanswered public questions are recorded for separately reviewed follow-up rather than invented answers.

s7 explicitly captures actual questions and commitments before its separate save. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. No website publication or email send is hidden in this live briefing. Provisional B=100, R=82, gross=18; incremental focal status/source upkeep=2; net=16. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual status-field completeness and required public approval chain.
research_questions: Trace a briefing from actual status updates to final public wording and capture all corrections and follow-up work.

already_counted.description: Completed briefing technical/disclosure review at s4

incremental.description: Maintain approved status mappings and inspect explanation failures

approvals.approved_version: complete final public briefing material and intended public audience
confirmed final actual public-briefing follow-up record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native status and templates already suffice; high allows five extra hours resolving actual-status gaps and public-wording corrections beyond central net 16.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist project budget administration and forecasts

steps.what: Retrieve actual project costs, commitments and the current approved budget
inputs: existing posted actual costs and open commitments
current approved project budget and cost-code mapping
outputs: source-linked budget and actual-cost extract

steps.what: Reconcile project cost codes, commitment coverage and actual budget discrepancies
inputs: source-linked budget and actual-cost extract
existing cost-code definitions
outputs: validated costs, commitments and unresolved discrepancies

steps.what: Estimate and record remaining engineering work quantities, timing and applicable rates
inputs: actual project progress and remaining scope
existing finance-approved rates and supplier commitments
outputs: engineer-confirmed remaining quantities, timing and rate references

steps.what: Calculate the updated budget forecast and variance using validated actuals and remaining work
inputs: validated costs, commitments and unresolved discrepancies
engineer-confirmed remaining quantities, timing and rate references
outputs: complete proposed budget forecast and variance calculations

steps.what: Analyse budget variances and decide which forecast assumptions need escalation
inputs: complete proposed budget forecast and variance calculations
actual scope and unresolved discrepancies
outputs: checked final forecast, explanations and escalation flags

steps.what: Approve the complete final forecast contribution and supporting assumptions
inputs: checked final forecast, explanations and escalation flags
outputs: approved final engineering forecast contribution

steps.what: Save the approved forecast contribution in the same project budget record
inputs: approved final engineering forecast contribution
outputs: saved engineering forecast contribution

tasks.design: Configure native {ERP} cost views and {PROJECT} forecast calculations around validated actuals and engineer-entered remaining work. Keep quantity estimates, variance judgement and final contribution approval with the engineer; fixed arithmetic needs no model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Posted costs do not supply remaining scope or a reliable completion estimate.
tasks.enabler_now: Native queries and formulas can combine validated actuals with explicit quantity/rate inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Estimate remaining work and recognise scope changes behind cost variances.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the engineering work that the budget represents.

ambition.what: Support current budget administration without granting spending authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify finance/project access and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project budget systems can combine structured actual costs, commitments, quantities and rates using fixed calculations.

assumptions: Finance and procurement staff already produce posted actual amount/currency/date/cost code and open commitment/coverage in their ordinary systems. s1 retrieves and s2 validates those records; missing or ambiguous cost mappings remain manual. No finance capture is assumed free or counted as engineer saving.

s3 counts producing and entering remaining item/activity, quantity/unit, expected timing and rate reference from actual progress and scope. Existing finance rate owner supplies approved unit rates and conversion rules. Missing quantities or rates stop calculation; no model guesses them.

Native budget views and formulas come first. Central retains 60% of retrieval and 40% of calculation handling, while source reconciliation, remaining-work estimation and variance judgement remain full time. Existing automated reports/formulas already running earn no additional saving.

Boundary is the engineer's budget contribution, not final budget-owner approval, invoice payment or expenditure commitment. s6 approves the finished contribution before s7 save; edits void approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Provisional B=100, R=78, gross=22; incremental focal mapping/formula upkeep=2; net=20. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Current native forecast coverage and actual quantity/rate completeness.
research_questions: Reproduce a forecast from actual costs and engineer-produced remaining quantities, counting all reconciliation and review time.

already_counted.description: Final engineering forecast approval at s6

incremental.description: Review cost mappings and forecast-formula changes

approvals.approved_version: complete final engineering forecast contribution, explanations and assumptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native forecasting already covers the work; high allows six extra hours resolving commitment coverage and quantity/rate exceptions beyond central net 20.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Engineers retain site, design, disclosure and forecast judgements; supported retrieval, fixed calculations and reviewed wording reduce specific administrative steps.
reach: Finance analyst: learn cost-code and commitment coverage rules
Site safety lead: learn local protocol sign-off requirements
skills_to_grow: Capture actual site and project values
Trace quantities and rates to producers
Review generated instruction and explanation meaning
role.ambitious_version: An environmental engineer gives source-grounded project advice, protocols and forecasts while keeping technical and disclosure decisions explicit.
